proposedFix: Map at least one active Product2 to an Evergreen ProductSellingModel via ProductSellingModelOption, add an active PricebookEntry for that product+selling-model in the Fortra Price Book, then build a Quote with that Evergreen QLI (AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true, itemTransientEndDate set to a mid-period date) to exercise the branch. notes: BLOCKED status unchanged from run1 and run2. The 4 Evergreen ProductSellingModel records exist but remain unmapped (0 PSMOs). Per method brief anti-phantom-defect doctrine, an un-instantiable scenario is BLOCKED, never FAIL.
